claims: Baseball umpires often work in crews of 1–6.
Baseball umpire crews include a plate umpire and field umpires.
Plate umpire stands behind home plate.
Plate umpire rules on most plays.
Field umpires are stationed at first, second, third bases.
Bureau of Labor Statistics data suggests varied income for sports officials.
Umpire protective gear includes mask, chest protector, shin guards.
